items.body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. To investigate a possible lock-ordering deadlock, we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces it without Harbor, LiteLLM or aiohttp: a short script with `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)` where a second thread or task prints or logs while the display refreshes. Please also paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`. Redirection behaviour is documented in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst and the locks are in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/live.py Related: #3125

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
